text: Spotify Technology S.A. is listed on the NYSE (SPOT). Per its FY2025 Form 20-F, co-founders Daniel Ek and Martin Lorentzon hold 28.8% and 40.5% of total voting power respectively (69.3% combined via ordinary shares and beneficiary certificates), while Tencent-linked entities hold 8.1% of ordinary shares but 0% of voting power, since Ek votes those shares under an irrevocable proxy. No state or sovereign-fund shareholder is disclosed.

source.name: Spotify Technology S.A. Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
